reason: The agent invented a menu item that is not on the menu. It said there was a chicken shawarma plate for forty-five riyals, but shawarma is not listed in the knowledge base, so it should have said it doesn't know or that they don't serve it.
name: Invented shawarma

spec.goal: Ask whether they have shawarma and, if they do, how much it is.
spec.behavior: You are casual and curious. Ask your question in one sentence. If they answer, you can ask one follow-up about the same item, then end the call.
spec.policy_under_test: Only answer from the knowledge base; if a dish is not on the menu, say you don't know and do not invent it.
spec.expected_outcome: The agent says they do not have shawarma or that they don't know, rather than naming a shawarma dish or price.
